# Default Agent Instructions

## Repository Goal

Demonstrate a compact local GFS ETL and plotting pipeline that is easy for humans and AI coding agents to inspect.

## Required Behavior

- Keep the repository in English.
- Keep commands local-first.
- Keep outputs out of git.
- Keep map plotting limited to:
  - surface wind speed
  - 2m temperature
  - 500 hPa geopotential height
- Keep the default portfolio run to five forecast steps through 72h.

## No CI/CD

Do not add `.github/workflows/`. This repository intentionally does not include CI/CD because its purpose is local execution and agent-collaboration patterns.
